$comment: Body kinds (docs/BUILT_BODIES.md §2, ADR 0052): what may be done to a moving body of voxel cells, by its kind. The order is the wire's (EntitySpawn's `kind`: 0 is the first). place: a block placed against one of its cells joins it. break: a cell of it may be broken. split: a break that leaves its cells in more than one connected group splits it into bodies of the same kind. settles: at rest it becomes blocks again (docs/FELLING.md §4); else it stays a body. settlesAfloat (optional, default false): it may settle while afloat (a cell in a liquid, the body lighter than it on the whole); false, it drifts with the current until it has been out of the water felling.json's beachSeconds (owner, 2026-11-12: floating trees "should never settle, it causes them to block up rivers randomly instead of floating downstream"; waterlogging, later, would sink a soaked body to settle on the bed). saved: saved with the world. builtOn: blocks a body of this kind is built on (the build platform; docs/BUILT_BODIES.md §3, owner 2026-11-02: "the platform on which the structure is built"): the block stays in the world's grid, and a block placed on its top starts a body of this kind there, held still while any of its cells rests on such a block; blocks placed touching a held body join it. Owner, 2026-11-02: natural objects (felled trees, falling sand, loose leaves) can only be broken, not built on; built ones (the build platform's) both; splits for both; built ones never settle. water: how bodies float (docs/BUILT_BODIES.md §6): each cell is pushed up by the liquid it is in (its fraction under it, sampled at its centre and corners) by the liquid's own density, and a body in water is slowed as in real water (owner, 2026-11-03: a heavy raft slow to start, gliding when let go): by ½ · the liquid's density · dragCoefficient · its area under water facing the motion · speed², plus drag (/s) on its sideways velocity (what stills a slow drift), heaveDrag (/s) on its up-and-down velocity (the waves a bob makes still it) and angularDrag (/s) on its spin, those three by how much of it is under. Run `node shared/physics/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-sim/src/bodies.gen.rs is stale.
